Name: Returning Player Experience Survey
ActivityDes:
Requirements: Commandant Lv.40

Event Info:
In order to create a better gaming environment, the Command Central has decided to conduct a survey regarding the in-game experiences of returning players. Please tap the [Advance] button below to share your thoughts! Rewards will be granted upon completion of the survey.

Name: Anchored in Faith
ActivityDes: Event Info: Play through the new story [Anchored in Faith] and complete missions.

Name: Simulated Battlefield
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.16.
Mission Info:
1. Earn Simulation Scores upon clearing a stage.
2. Spend Simulation Scores to purchase items at the Simulation Shop.
3. The limited-time shop exchange ends on November 5, 2026, at 05:00 (UTC).
4. During the event period, clear Simulated Battlefield stages and consume a certain amount of serum to claim rewards.

Name: Dream of Stagnant Cycle
ActivityDes:
Collab Story - Dream of Stagnant Cycle
The collab story Dream of Stagnant Cycle is now available! Commandants can experience the new story content during this event.
Requirement: Clear Normal Story 1-12
Event Period: September 29, 2026 10:00 - November 3, 2026 23:59 (UTC)

Name: Circuit Calculus
ActivityDes:
Requirements: Commandant Lv.40
Event Info:
1. Join Adelyde at the card table and find the optimal solution to this simulation!
2. The event consists of 9 stages. The Endless Stage unlocks after you clear the first 8 stages.
3. Choose your characters and CUBs, select the right skills and equipment, and build your squad to defeat enemies.
4. Complete the designated challenges to claim Event Construct R&D Tickets, Trade Vouchers, and other items.

Name: Overclock Simulation
ActivityDes:
Requirements: Commandant Lv.40
Event Info
1. Enter Overclock Simulation and take control of enhanced classic frames to battle powerful bosses.
2. The event consists of 4 chapters. New chapters will unlock as the event progresses once their prerequisites have been cleared.
3. In Peak Calculation, you can deploy your own characters and compete against players across all servers for a rare, limited-time animated chat frame.
4. Clear missions to claim rewards including Event Construct R&D Tickets, Trade Vouchers, Collectibles, and more.

Name: Shrouded Requiem
ActivityDes:
Requirements: 
Commandant Lv.40
Event Info:
1. New Nirvatia story added to Nightshroud Tales. Tap [Nightshroud Tales] on the event interface to enter.
2. Permanent shop updated. Spend permanent tokens to redeem rewards such as [Event Construct R&D Tickets] and [Stamps].

Name: Wreck-It Huhu
ActivityDes:
Requirements: Commandant Lv.40
Event Info:
1. This event introduces the enhancement system. Clear Special Cubes to earn enhancements. Use items to clear more cubes.
2. The event has 3 chapters, with 4 stages each. Each stage becomes available either over time or after you clear the previous one.
3. Every stage has a turn limit. You may end the game early after reaching the specified turn count or rating.
4. You can move one cube per turn. Meet the requirements to clear cubes and rack up points.
5. You'll get a rating based on your score, which lets you claim event rewards accordingly.

Name: Wrathful Monsoon
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.40
Event Info:
1. There are a total of 5 difficulty levels, all of which are highly challenging with [Rusalka: Cruising Vanguard] being your formidable enemy.
2. All members will be reset once knocked out during the challenge, making the challenge easier to complete.
3. Each stage has its own 3-star clearance conditions. Earn stars across all stages to claim Collectible rewards. The more stars you collect, the higher the Collectible's quality.

ActivityDes:
Requirements:

Event Info:
